graph.description: FalkorDB configuration key-value map that will be encoded into the FALKORDB_ARGS environment variable.

THREAD_COUNT.description: Number of threads in FalkorDB's thread pool. Equivalent to max concurrent queries. Default: unset. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#thread_count

CACHE_SIZE.description: Max number of queries cached by FalkorDB. When full, least-recently-used entries are evicted. Default: 25. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#cache_size

OMP_THREAD_COUNT.description: Maximum number of OpenMP threads used for GraphBLAS computation per query. Default: unset. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#omp_thread_count

NODE_CREATION_BUFFER.description: Number of new nodes that can be created before matrix resize is required. Default: 16384. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#node_creation_buffer

BOLT_PORT.description: Bolt protocol port; -1 disables the Bolt listener. Default: -1. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#bolt_port

MAX_QUEUED_QUERIES.description: Maximum number of queued queries before new requests are rejected. Default: 9007199254740991. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#max_queued_queries

TIMEOUT_MAX.description: Maximum execution time for read/write queries in milliseconds (since v2.10). Default: 0. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#timeout_max

TIMEOUT_DEFAULT.description: Default execution timeout in milliseconds (since v2.10), bounded by TIMEOUT_MAX. Default: 0. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#timeout_default

RESULTSET_SIZE.description: Maximum number of records returned by a query; -1 means unlimited. Default: -1. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#resultset_size

QUERY_MEM_CAPACITY.description: Maximum bytes a single query may allocate; 0 means unlimited. Default: 0. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#query_mem_capacity

VKEY_MAX_ENTITY_COUNT.description: Number of graph entities per virtual key during replication. Default: 100000. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#vkey_max_entity_count

EFFECTS_THRESHOLD.description: Replicate modifications via effects when average modification time exceeds this threshold (microseconds). Default: 300. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#effects_threshold

CMD_INFO.description: Enable or disable GRAPH.INFO command (yes/no). Default: unset. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#cmd_info

MAX_INFO_QUERIES.description: Maximum number of query records retained in telemetry stream (range 0-1000). Default: 1000. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#max_info_queries

DELTA_MAX_PENDING_CHANGES.description: Maximum number of pending delta changes before they must be processed. Default: 10000. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#delta_max_pending_changes

IMPORT_FOLDER.description: Absolute path from which FalkorDB is allowed to import CSV files. Default: /var/lib/FalkorDB/import/. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#import_folder

falkordbe.idle-threshold-ms.description: Idle threshold (ms). LRU idle time before a graph is automatically offloaded. 0 disables background eviction. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.evict-interval-ms.description: Eviction interval (ms). How often the eviction thread scans the keyspace for idle graphs. Minimum 1000 ms. Default: 10000. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.memory-pressure.description: Memory pressure watermark. Fraction of used_memory/maxmemory above which the eviction thread starts offloading idle graphs. 0 disables the check. Requires Redis maxmemory to be set: without it the ratio is always 0 and any positive value suppresses all eviction. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.load-evict-budget.description: Load eviction budget. Maximum number of live graphs the module may offload to free memory for a single GRAPH.LOAD. 0 disables OOM-triggered eviction, -1 allows unlimited evictions. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.ldap_servers.description: LDAP servers. Comma separated list of LDAP URLs of the form ldap[s]://<host>:<port>. Leaving this empty keeps LDAP authentication switched off. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_auth_mode.description: Authentication mode. How a client is authenticated: bind builds the DN from the prefix/suffix, search+bind first looks the user up with the search account. Default: bind. One of: bind, search+bind. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_bind_dn_prefix.description: Bind DN prefix. Prepended to the username from the AUTH command when forming the bind DN. Only used in bind mode. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_bind_dn_suffix.description: Bind DN suffix. Appended to the username from the AUTH command when forming the bind DN. Only used in bind mode. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_base.description: Search base. Root DN where the search for the user entry begins. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_filter.description: Search filter. LDAP filter applied when searching for the user entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_scope.description: Search scope. Scope of the user search. Default: sub. One of: base, one, sub. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_attribute.description: Search attribute. Entry attribute matched against the username supplied in the AUTH command. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_dn_attribute.description: Search DN attribute. Attribute holding the DN of the matched user entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_bind_dn.description: Search bind DN. DN of the service account used to perform the user search. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

anyOf.description: Search bind password. Password of the search service account. Stored in the cluster configuration in clear text and readable by anyone who can read the ConfigMap, so use a dedicated read-only directory account. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. A credential: never returned by the API. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_connection_pool_size.description: Connection pool size. Number of pooled connections per LDAP server. 1 to 8192. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_connection.description: Connection timeout (s). Seconds to wait when connecting to an LDAP server. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_ldap_operation.description: Operation timeout (s). Seconds to wait for a single LDAP operation to complete. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_failure_detector_interval.description: Failure detector interval (s). Seconds between two runs of the server failure detector. Default: 1. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_use_starttls.description: Use StartTLS. Upgrade a plain LDAP connection to TLS with the StartTLS operation (RFC 4513). Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_ca_cert_path.description: TLS CA certificate path. Path to the CA certificate used to validate the LDAP server certificate. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_cert_path.description: TLS client certificate path. Path to the client certificate presented to the LDAP server. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_key_path.description: TLS client key path. Path to the private key of the client certificate. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS verification. Accept any certificate presented by the LDAP server, including self-signed and expired ones. This removes the protection against man-in-the-middle attacks and must not be enabled outside development. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_exempted_users_regex.description: Exempted users regex. Usernames matching this pattern bypass LDAP and authenticate against the local ACL. Keep the operational accounts here, for example ^(default|exporter|replication)$. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_return_auth_errors.description: Return authentication errors. Report the directory error back to the client instead of a generic failure. Useful while setting LDAP up, but it discloses directory details. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_acl_fallback_enabled.description: ACL fallback. Cache the password in the ACL on a successful LDAP login so the user can still authenticate while the directory is unreachable. Rejected credentials never fall back. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_default_acl_rules.description: Default ACL rules. ACL rule tokens always applied alongside the tokens provided by LDAP groups. Default: on resetpass. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_search_base.description: Groups search base. DN under which groups are searched. Falls back to the user search base when empty. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_filter.description: Groups filter. LDAP filter applied when searching for groups. Default: objectClass=groupOfNames. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_name_attribute.description: Group name attribute. Attribute of a group entry used as the group name when mapping to ACLs. Default: cn. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_member_attribute.description: Group member attribute. Attribute of a group entry that references the user DN. Default: member. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_rules_attribute.description: Group rules attribute. Attribute of a group entry holding space delimited ACL rule tokens that are applied to the user at login. Default: valkeyACL. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_group_acl_rules_map.description: Group to ACL rules map. Static mapping of LDAP groups to ACL rule tokens, used instead of reading them from the group entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_group_acl_user_map.description: Group to ACL user map. Legacy comma separated group=acluser mapping. After a successful bind the client is authenticated as the mapped ACL user. Prefer the rule based mapping above. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_filter.description: Search filter. LDAP filter applied when searching for the user entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_scope.description: Search scope. Scope of the user search. Default: sub. One of: base, one, sub. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_attribute.description: Search attribute. Entry attribute matched against the username supplied in the AUTH command. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_dn_attribute.description: Search DN attribute. Attribute holding the DN of the matched user entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_bind_dn.description: Search bind DN. DN of the service account used to perform the user search. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

anyOf.description: Search bind password. Password of the search service account. Stored in the cluster configuration in clear text and readable by anyone who can read the ConfigMap, so use a dedicated read-only directory account. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. A credential: never returned by the API. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_connection_pool_size.description: Connection pool size. Number of pooled connections per LDAP server. 1 to 8192. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_connection.description: Connection timeout (s). Seconds to wait when connecting to an LDAP server. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_ldap_operation.description: Operation timeout (s). Seconds to wait for a single LDAP operation to complete. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_failure_detector_interval.description: Failure detector interval (s). Seconds between two runs of the server failure detector. Default: 1. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_use_starttls.description: Use StartTLS. Upgrade a plain LDAP connection to TLS with the StartTLS operation (RFC 4513). Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_ca_cert_path.description: TLS CA certificate path. Path to the CA certificate used to validate the LDAP server certificate. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_cert_path.description: TLS client certificate path. Path to the client certificate presented to the LDAP server. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_key_path.description: TLS client key path. Path to the private key of the client certificate. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS verification. Accept any certificate presented by the LDAP server, including self-signed and expired ones. This removes the protection against man-in-the-middle attacks and must not be enabled outside development. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_exempted_users_regex.description: Exempted users regex. Usernames matching this pattern bypass LDAP and authenticate against the local ACL. Keep the operational accounts here, for example ^(default|exporter|replication)$. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_return_auth_errors.description: Return authentication errors. Report the directory error back to the client instead of a generic failure. Useful while setting LDAP up, but it discloses directory details. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_acl_fallback_enabled.description: ACL fallback. Cache the password in the ACL on a successful LDAP login so the user can still authenticate while the directory is unreachable. Rejected credentials never fall back. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_default_acl_rules.description: Default ACL rules. ACL rule tokens always applied alongside the tokens provided by LDAP groups. Default: on resetpass. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_search_base.description: Groups search base. DN under which groups are searched. Falls back to the user search base when empty. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_filter.description: Groups filter. LDAP filter applied when searching for groups. Default: objectClass=groupOfNames. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_name_attribute.description: Group name attribute. Attribute of a group entry used as the group name when mapping to ACLs. Default: cn. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_member_attribute.description: Group member attribute. Attribute of a group entry that references the user DN. Default: member. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_rules_attribute.description: Group rules attribute. Attribute of a group entry holding space delimited ACL rule tokens that are applied to the user at login. Default: valkeyACL. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_group_acl_rules_map.description: Group to ACL rules map. Static mapping of LDAP groups to ACL rule tokens, used instead of reading them from the group entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_group_acl_user_map.description: Group to ACL user map. Legacy comma separated group=acluser mapping. After a successful bind the client is authenticated as the mapped ACL user. Prefer the rule based mapping above. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

config.description: FalkorDB configuration key-value map that will be encoded into the FALKORDB_ARGS environment variable.

THREAD_COUNT.description: Number of threads in FalkorDB's thread pool. Equivalent to max concurrent queries. Default: unset. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#thread_count

CACHE_SIZE.description: Max number of queries cached by FalkorDB. When full, least-recently-used entries are evicted. Default: 25. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#cache_size

OMP_THREAD_COUNT.description: Maximum number of OpenMP threads used for GraphBLAS computation per query. Default: unset. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#omp_thread_count

NODE_CREATION_BUFFER.description: Number of new nodes that can be created before matrix resize is required. Default: 16384. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#node_creation_buffer

BOLT_PORT.description: Bolt protocol port; -1 disables the Bolt listener. Default: -1. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#bolt_port

MAX_QUEUED_QUERIES.description: Maximum number of queued queries before new requests are rejected. Default: 9007199254740991. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#max_queued_queries

TIMEOUT_MAX.description: Maximum execution time for read/write queries in milliseconds (since v2.10). Default: 0. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#timeout_max

TIMEOUT_DEFAULT.description: Default execution timeout in milliseconds (since v2.10), bounded by TIMEOUT_MAX. Default: 0. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#timeout_default

RESULTSET_SIZE.description: Maximum number of records returned by a query; -1 means unlimited. Default: -1. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#resultset_size

QUERY_MEM_CAPACITY.description: Maximum bytes a single query may allocate; 0 means unlimited. Default: 0. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#query_mem_capacity

VKEY_MAX_ENTITY_COUNT.description: Number of graph entities per virtual key during replication. Default: 100000. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#vkey_max_entity_count

EFFECTS_THRESHOLD.description: Replicate modifications via effects when average modification time exceeds this threshold (microseconds). Default: 300. CMD_INFO.description: Enable or disable GRAPH.INFO command (yes/no). Default: unset. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#cmd_info

falkordbe.idle-threshold-ms.description: Idle threshold (ms). LRU idle time before a graph is automatically offloaded. 0 disables background eviction. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.evict-interval-ms.description: Eviction interval (ms). How often the eviction thread scans the keyspace for idle graphs. Minimum 1000 ms. Default: 10000. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.memory-pressure.description: Memory pressure watermark. Fraction of used_memory/maxmemory above which the eviction thread starts offloading idle graphs. 0 disables the check. Requires Redis maxmemory to be set: without it the ratio is always 0 and any positive value suppresses all eviction. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.load-evict-budget.description: Load eviction budget. Maximum number of live graphs the module may offload to free memory for a single GRAPH.LOAD. 0 disables OOM-triggered eviction, -1 allows unlimited evictions. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.ldap_servers.description: LDAP servers. Comma separated list of LDAP URLs of the form ldap[s]://<host>:<port>. Leaving this empty keeps LDAP authentication switched off. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_auth_mode.description: Authentication mode. How a client is authenticated: bind builds the DN from the prefix/suffix, search+bind first looks the user up with the search account. Default: bind. One of: bind, search+bind. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_bind_dn_prefix.description: Bind DN prefix. Prepended to the username from the AUTH command when forming the bind DN. Only used in bind mode. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_bind_dn_suffix.description: Bind DN suffix. Appended to the username from the AUTH command when forming the bind DN. Only used in bind mode. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_base.description: Search base. Root DN where the search for the user entry begins. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_filter.description: Search filter. LDAP filter applied when searching for the user entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_scope.description: Search scope. Scope of the user search. Default: sub. One of: base, one, sub. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_attribute.description: Search attribute. Entry attribute matched against the username supplied in the AUTH command. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_dn_attribute.description: Search DN attribute. Attribute holding the DN of the matched user entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_bind_dn.description: Search bind DN. DN of the service account used to perform the user search. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

anyOf.description: Search bind password. Password of the search service account. Stored in the cluster configuration in clear text and readable by anyone who can read the ConfigMap, so use a dedicated read-only directory account. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. A credential: never returned by the API. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_connection_pool_size.description: Connection pool size. Number of pooled connections per LDAP server. 1 to 8192. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_connection.description: Connection timeout (s). Seconds to wait when connecting to an LDAP server. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_ldap_operation.description: Operation timeout (s). Seconds to wait for a single LDAP operation to complete. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_failure_detector_interval.description: Failure detector interval (s). Seconds between two runs of the server failure detector. Default: 1. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_use_starttls.description: Use StartTLS. Upgrade a plain LDAP connection to TLS with the StartTLS operation (RFC 4513). Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_ca_cert_path.description: TLS CA certificate path. Path to the CA certificate used to validate the LDAP server certificate. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_cert_path.description: TLS client certificate path. Path to the client certificate presented to the LDAP server. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_key_path.description: TLS client key path. Path to the private key of the client certificate. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS verification. Accept any certificate presented by the LDAP server, including self-signed and expired ones. This removes the protection against man-in-the-middle attacks and must not be enabled outside development. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_exempted_users_regex.description: Exempted users regex. Usernames matching this pattern bypass LDAP and authenticate against the local ACL. Keep the operational accounts here, for example ^(default|exporter|replication)$. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_return_auth_errors.description: Return authentication errors. Report the directory error back to the client instead of a generic failure. Useful while setting LDAP up, but it discloses directory details. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_acl_fallback_enabled.description: ACL fallback. Cache the password in the ACL on a successful LDAP login so the user can still authenticate while the directory is unreachable. Rejected credentials never fall back. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_default_acl_rules.description: Default ACL rules. ACL rule tokens always applied alongside the tokens provided by LDAP groups. Default: on resetpass. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_search_base.description: Groups search base. DN under which groups are searched. Falls back to the user search base when empty. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_filter.description: Groups filter. LDAP filter applied when searching for groups. Default: objectClass=groupOfNames. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_name_attribute.description: Group name attribute. Attribute of a group entry used as the group name when mapping to ACLs. Default: cn. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_member_attribute.description: Group member attribute. Attribute of a group entry that references the user DN. Default: member. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_rules_attribute.description: Group rules attribute. Attribute of a group entry holding space delimited ACL rule tokens that are applied to the user at login. Default: valkeyACL. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_group_acl_rules_map.description: Group to ACL rules map. Static mapping of LDAP groups to ACL rule tokens, used instead of reading them from the group entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_group_acl_user_map.description: Group to ACL user map. Legacy comma separated group=acluser mapping. After a successful bind the client is authenticated as the mapped ACL user. Prefer the rule based mapping above. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

enterpriseConfig.description: FalkorDB Enterprise module settings applied through a Reconfiguring OpsRequest after the cluster becomes ready.

falkordbe.idle-threshold-ms.description: Idle threshold (ms). LRU idle time before a graph is automatically offloaded. 0 disables background eviction. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.evict-interval-ms.description: Eviction interval (ms). How often the eviction thread scans the keyspace for idle graphs. Minimum 1000 ms. Default: 10000. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.memory-pressure.description: Memory pressure watermark. Fraction of used_memory/maxmemory above which the eviction thread starts offloading idle graphs. 0 disables the check. Requires Redis maxmemory to be set: without it the ratio is always 0 and any positive value suppresses all eviction. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.load-evict-budget.description: Load eviction budget. Maximum number of live graphs the module may offload to free memory for a single GRAPH.LOAD. 0 disables OOM-triggered eviction, -1 allows unlimited evictions. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.ldap_servers.description: LDAP servers. Comma separated list of LDAP URLs of the form ldap[s]://<host>:<port>. Leaving this empty keeps LDAP authentication switched off. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_auth_mode.description: Authentication mode. How a client is authenticated: bind builds the DN from the prefix/suffix, search+bind first looks the user up with the search account. Default: bind. One of: bind, search+bind. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_bind_dn_prefix.description: Bind DN prefix. Prepended to the username from the AUTH command when forming the bind DN. Only used in bind mode. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_bind_dn_suffix.description: Bind DN suffix. Appended to the username from the AUTH command when forming the bind DN. Only used in bind mode. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_base.description: Search base. Root DN where the search for the user entry begins. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_filter.description: Search filter. LDAP filter applied when searching for the user entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_scope.description: Search scope. Scope of the user search. Default: sub. One of: base, one, sub. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_attribute.description: Search attribute. Entry attribute matched against the username supplied in the AUTH command. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_dn_attribute.description: Search DN attribute. Attribute holding the DN of the matched user entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_bind_dn.description: Search bind DN. DN of the service account used to perform the user search. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_bind_passwd.description: Search bind password. Password of the search service account. Stored in the cluster configuration in clear text and readable by anyone who can read the ConfigMap, so use a dedicated read-only directory account. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. A credential: never returned by the API. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_connection_pool_size.description: Connection pool size. Number of pooled connections per LDAP server. 1 to 8192. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_connection.description: Connection timeout (s). Seconds to wait when connecting to an LDAP server. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_ldap_operation.description: Operation timeout (s). Seconds to wait for a single LDAP operation to complete. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_failure_detector_interval.description: Failure detector interval (s). Seconds between two runs of the server failure detector. Default: 1. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_use_starttls.description: Use StartTLS. Upgrade a plain LDAP connection to TLS with the StartTLS operation (RFC 4513). Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_ca_cert_path.description: TLS CA certificate path. Path to the CA certificate used to validate the LDAP server certificate. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_cert_path.description: TLS client certificate path. Path to the client certificate presented to the LDAP server. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_key_path.description: TLS client key path. Path to the private key of the client certificate. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS verification. Accept any certificate presented by the LDAP server, including self-signed and expired ones. This removes the protection against man-in-the-middle attacks and must not be enabled outside development. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_exempted_users_regex.description: Exempted users regex. Usernames matching this pattern bypass LDAP and authenticate against the local ACL. Keep the operational accounts here, for example ^(default|exporter|replication)$. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_return_auth_errors.description: Return authentication errors. Report the directory error back to the client instead of a generic failure. Useful while setting LDAP up, but it discloses directory details. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_acl_fallback_enabled.description: ACL fallback. Cache the password in the ACL on a successful LDAP login so the user can still authenticate while the directory is unreachable. Rejected credentials never fall back. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_default_acl_rules.description: Default ACL rules. ACL rule tokens always applied alongside the tokens provided by LDAP groups. Default: on resetpass. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_search_base.description: Groups search base. DN under which groups are searched. Falls back to the user search base when empty. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_filter.description: Groups filter. LDAP filter applied when searching for groups. Default: objectClass=groupOfNames. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_name_attribute.description: Group name attribute. Attribute of a group entry used as the group name when mapping to ACLs. Default: cn. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_member_attribute.description: Group member attribute. Attribute of a group entry that references the user DN. Default: member. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_groups_rules_attribute.description: Group rules attribute. Attribute of a group entry holding space delimited ACL rule tokens that are applied to the user at login. Default: valkeyACL. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_group_acl_rules_map.description: Group to ACL rules map. Static mapping of LDAP groups to ACL rule tokens, used instead of reading them from the group entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_group_acl_user_map.description: Group to ACL user map. Legacy comma separated group=acluser mapping. After a successful bind the client is authenticated as the mapped ACL user. Prefer the rule based mapping above. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

externalDomain.description: DNS domain under which per-pod records are published, e.g. 'db.internal.example.com'. Requires routable pod IPs and an ExternalDNS instance.

tls.description: TLS for every component. Enterprise and KubeBlocks take no other fields; UserProvided requires secretRef; CertManager requires issuerRef. KubeBlocks only works for standalone deployments and replication without Sentinel.

secretRef.description: Required when issuer is UserProvided: the Secret holding the certificate, key and CA.

namespace.description: Must be a valid Kubernetes object name: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; must start and end with a letter or number; max 63 characters.

ca.description: Key of the CA certificate (default ca.crt)

key.description: Key of the private key (default tls.key)

issuerRef.description: Required when issuer is CertManager: the Issuer (in the deployment's namespace) or ClusterIssuer that signs the certificates.

auth.description: Credentials of the default account. When omitted, KubeBlocks generates a password.

username.description: Only the built-in default account can be set at create time

password.description: Password of the default account. Letters, digits and !@#$%^&*()_+=.,:;?~- only.

backup.description: Recurring backup to set up once the deployment is running. It uses the default backup repository.

schedule.description: Cron expression of the recurring backup

retentionPeriod.description: How long backups are kept, e.g. 7d

name.description: Must be a valid Kubernetes object name: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; must start and end with a letter or number; max 63 characters.

falkordbe.idle-threshold-ms.description: Idle threshold (ms). LRU idle time before a graph is automatically offloaded. 0 disables background eviction. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.evict-interval-ms.description: Eviction interval (ms). How often the eviction thread scans the keyspace for idle graphs. Minimum 1000 ms. Default: 10000. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.memory-pressure.description: Memory pressure watermark. Fraction of used_memory/maxmemory above which the eviction thread starts offloading idle graphs. 0 disables the check. Requires Redis maxmemory to be set: without it the ratio is always 0 and any positive value suppresses all eviction. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.load-evict-budget.description: Load eviction budget. Maximum number of live graphs the module may offload to free memory for a single GRAPH.LOAD. 0 disables OOM-triggered eviction, -1 allows unlimited evictions. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.ldap_servers.description: LDAP servers. Comma separated list of LDAP URLs of the form ldap[s]://<host>:<port>. Leaving this empty keeps LDAP authentication switched off. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_auth_mode.description: Authentication mode. How a client is authenticated: bind builds the DN from the prefix/suffix, search+bind first looks the user up with the search account. Default: bind. One of: bind, search+bind. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_bind_dn_prefix.description: Bind DN prefix. Prepended to the username from the AUTH command when forming the bind DN. Only used in bind mode. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_bind_dn_suffix.description: Bind DN suffix. Appended to the username from the AUTH command when forming the bind DN. Only used in bind mode. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_base.description: Search base. Root DN where the search for the user entry begins. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_filter.description: Search filter. LDAP filter applied when searching for the user entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_scope.description: Search scope. Scope of the user search. Default: sub. One of: base, one, sub. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_attribute.description: Search attribute. Entry attribute matched against the username supplied in the AUTH command. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_dn_attribute.description: Search DN attribute. Attribute holding the DN of the matched user entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_bind_dn.description: Search bind DN. DN of the service account used to perform the user search. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

anyOf.description: Search bind password. Password of the search service account. Stored in the cluster configuration in clear text and readable by anyone who can read the ConfigMap, so use a dedicated read-only directory account. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. A credential: never returned by the API. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_connection_pool_size.description: Connection pool size. Number of pooled connections per LDAP server. 1 to 8192. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_connection.description: Connection timeout (s). Seconds to wait when connecting to an LDAP server. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_ldap_operation.description: Operation timeout (s). Seconds to wait for a single LDAP operation to complete. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_failure_detector_interval.description: Failure detector interval (s). Seconds between two runs of the server failure detector. Default: 1. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_use_starttls.description: Use StartTLS. Upgrade a plain LDAP connection to TLS with the StartTLS operation (RFC 4513). Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_ca_cert_path.description: TLS CA certificate path. Path to the CA certificate used to validate the LDAP server certificate. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_cert_path.description: TLS client certificate path. Path to the client certificate presented to the LDAP server. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_key_path.description: TLS client key path. Path to the private key of the client certificate. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS verification. Accept any certificate presented by the LDAP server, including self-signed and expired ones. This removes the protection against man-in-the-middle attacks and must not be enabled outside development. Default: no. One of: yes, no. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. CMD_INFO.description: Enable or disable GRAPH.INFO command (yes/no). Default: unset. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#cmd_info

MAX_INFO_QUERIES.description: Maximum number of query records retained in telemetry stream (range 0-1000). Default: 1000. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#max_info_queries

DELTA_MAX_PENDING_CHANGES.description: Maximum number of pending delta changes before they must be processed. Default: 10000. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#delta_max_pending_changes

IMPORT_FOLDER.description: Absolute path from which FalkorDB is allowed to import CSV files. Default: /var/lib/FalkorDB/import/. Passed on the server command line; changing it restarts the pods. See https://docs.falkordb.com/getting-started/configuration.html#import_folder

falkordbe.idle-threshold-ms.description: Idle threshold (ms). LRU idle time before a graph is automatically offloaded. 0 disables background eviction. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.evict-interval-ms.description: Eviction interval (ms). How often the eviction thread scans the keyspace for idle graphs. Minimum 1000 ms. Default: 10000. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.memory-pressure.description: Memory pressure watermark. Fraction of used_memory/maxmemory above which the eviction thread starts offloading idle graphs. 0 disables the check. Requires Redis maxmemory to be set: without it the ratio is always 0 and any positive value suppresses all eviction. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.load-evict-budget.description: Load eviction budget. Maximum number of live graphs the module may offload to free memory for a single GRAPH.LOAD. 0 disables OOM-triggered eviction, -1 allows unlimited evictions. Default: 0. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/graph-offloading.md

falkordbe.ldap_servers.description: LDAP servers. Comma separated list of LDAP URLs of the form ldap[s]://<host>:<port>. Leaving this empty keeps LDAP authentication switched off. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_auth_mode.description: Authentication mode. How a client is authenticated: bind builds the DN from the prefix/suffix, search+bind first looks the user up with the search account. Default: bind. One of: bind, search+bind. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_bind_dn_prefix.description: Bind DN prefix. Prepended to the username from the AUTH command when forming the bind DN. Only used in bind mode. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_bind_dn_suffix.description: Bind DN suffix. Appended to the username from the AUTH command when forming the bind DN. Only used in bind mode. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_base.description: Search base. Root DN where the search for the user entry begins. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_filter.description: Search filter. LDAP filter applied when searching for the user entry. Default: unset. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_scope.description: Search scope. Scope of the user search. Default: sub. One of: base, one, sub. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_attribute.description: Search attribute. Entry attribute matched against the username supplied in the AUTH command. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_dn_attribute.description: Search DN attribute. Attribute holding the DN of the matched user entry. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_search_bind_dn.description: Search bind DN. DN of the service account used to perform the user search. Default: unset. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null or an empty value empties it again. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

anyOf.description: Search bind password. Password of the search service account. Stored in the cluster configuration in clear text and readable by anyone who can read the ConfigMap, so use a dedicated read-only directory account. Default: unset. falkordbe.ldap_connection_pool_size.description: Connection pool size. Number of pooled connections per LDAP server. 1 to 8192. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_connection.description: Connection timeout (s). Seconds to wait when connecting to an LDAP server. Default: 2. Applied to the running pods with a Reconfiguring OpsRequest, without a restart. On an update, null sets it back to its default. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_timeout_ldap_operation.description: Operation timeout (s). Seconds to wait for a single LDAP operation to complete. Default: 2. See https://github.com/FalkorDB/falkordb-enterprise-module/blob/main/docs/ldap.md

falkordbe.ldap_failure_detector_interval.description: Failure detector interval (s). Seconds between two runs of the server failure detector. Default: 1. falkordbe.ldap_tls_ca_cert_path.description: TLS CA certificate path. Path to the CA certificate used to validate the LDAP server certificate. The file has to be mounted into the FalkorDB pods.
